headline: H-ONE Co., Ltd. Details Cyber Attack in Regulatory Filing
body: H-ONE Co., Ltd. has filed a regulatory disclosure outlining a recent ransomware attack that affected its IT systems. The filing did not mention any ransom demands, but highlighted the company's commitment to resolving the issue and strengthening its cybersecurity measures.
